strings.ext.intro: Brave Shields is already a native ad/tracker blocker (same filter-list lineage as uBlock Origin, runs in-engine so slightly faster). We do NOT force-install anything - that would show a 'Managed by your organization' banner and lock the extension on. These buttons just open the install pages in Brave so you can decide.
strings.ext.warn: Caution: running uBlock Origin on top of Shields = double-blocking. Wastes CPU per tab and can break sites Shields handles fine. If you install uBO, consider switching Shields to Standard (not Aggressive) to reduce overlap.
strings.filter.label: Filter configuration:
strings.filter.placeholder: Type to filter every setting (name, description, category)...
strings.header.originNote: Context: Brave described Origin on April 16, 2026 as a minimalist build, then put that stripped-down idea behind a paywall. This is the free local version.
strings.header.subtitle: Strip out the AI, crypto, VPN, promo junk, and background clutter Brave stuffed in, then tune it for a lighter desktop footprint.
strings.hosts.components.description: WARNING: blocking this stops Widevine/CRX/iOS-style components from updating. Use only if ComponentUpdatesEnabled is also off.
strings.hosts.components.name: Component Updates
strings.hosts.news.description: News content CDN. Block ONLY if you have disabled News - unblocking is needed if you ever re-enable it.
strings.hosts.news.name: Brave News CDN
strings.hosts.p3a.description: Privacy-preserving analytics endpoints. Pure telemetry, never user-facing. Safe to block.
strings.hosts.p3a.name: Brave P3A telemetry
strings.hosts.rewards.description: Brave Rewards (BAT) servers. Block ONLY if you do not use Rewards. Will break the feature if you turn it on later.
strings.hosts.rewards.name: Brave Rewards / BAT
strings.hosts.stats.description: Daily/weekly/monthly anonymous usage ping. Safe to block.
strings.hosts.stats.name: Brave Stats ping
strings.hosts.variations.description: Field-trial / experiment config. Safe to block - matches ChromeVariations=2 policy.
strings.hosts.variations.name: Brave Variations
strings.hosts.webDiscovery.description: Web Discovery Project endpoints. Already covered by BraveWebDiscoveryEnabled policy; only useful if policy is bypassed.
strings.hosts.webDiscovery.name: Web Discovery
strings.hostsTab.intro: Optional second layer of defense: nullroute Brave telemetry domains in C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts. Even if a policy is bypassed by an update, the network call still fails. Sentinel-tagged for clean revert. Backups land in Documents\Brave-Free-Origin-Backups.
strings.hostsTab.warn: Independent of the "Apply to Brave" button. Use the buttons in this tab to apply or remove the hosts block.

strings.policy.AccessibilityImageLabelsEnabled.d: Disable cloud image-description service (sends images to Google).
strings.policy.AlternateErrorPagesEnabled.descri: Disable Google-hosted suggestion page on DNS errors.
strings.policy.AutofillAddressEnabled.descriptio: Disable autofill of addresses / contact info.
strings.policy.BackgroundModeEnabled.description: Stop Brave from running in the background after window close.
strings.policy.BatterySaverModeAvailability.desc: Allow Battery Saver on low battery (2). 1=always on unplugged, 0=disabled.
strings.policy.BookmarkBarEnabled.description: Hide bookmark bar globally (small render win). Unticking lets user toggle.
strings.policy.BraveDeAmpEnabled.description: Bypass Google AMP pages to reach publisher directly. (Leave ON for privacy.)
strings.policy.BraveDebouncingEnabled.descriptio: Protect against bounce-tracking redirect chains. (Leave ON for privacy.)
Enable Sec-GPC "do not sell/share" signal. (Leave ON for privacy.)
strings.policy.BraveNewsDisabled.description: Disable Brave News feed on the new tab page.
strings.policy.BraveReduceLanguageEnabled.descri: Reduce language-preference fingerprinting. (Leave ON for privacy.)
strings.policy.BraveRewardsDisabled.description: Disable Brave Rewards (BAT ads/tips) and hide all Rewards UI.
strings.policy.BraveTrackingQueryParametersFilte: Strip tracking params (utm_, fbclid, etc.) from URLs. (Leave ON for privacy.)
strings.policy.BraveVPNDisabled.description: Disable Brave VPN integration and all VPN UI.
strings.policy.BraveWaybackMachineEnabled.descri: Disable the "Check Wayback Machine" prompt on 404 pages.
strings.policy.BraveWebDiscoveryEnabled.descript: Disable Web Discovery Project search index contribution.
strings.policy.BrowserLabsEnabled.description: Hide the Labs / experimental features icon in the toolbar.
strings.policy.BuiltInDnsClientEnabled.descripti: Use OS resolver instead of async DoH client. Only tick if you want OS DNS.
strings.policy.ChromeCleanupEnabled.description: Disable the software-cleanup scanner (harmless on Brave).
strings.policy.ChromeCleanupReportingEnabled.des: Disable reporting from the cleanup scanner.
strings.policy.ChromeVariations.description: Opt out of all Chromium field trials/experiments (2). 1=critical only, 0=all.
strings.policy.ComponentUpdatesEnabled.descripti: Disable Chromium component updates (e.g. Widevine). Only tick if you know what this breaks.
strings.policy.DefaultBraveRemember1PStorageSett: Forget first-party storage on tab close (2). 1=Remember.
strings.policy.DiskCacheSize.description: Cap disk cache at 250 MB (value in bytes). Prevents unbounded cache growth on SSDs.
strings.policy.DnsOverHttpsMode.description: Allow DoH ("automatic"). Set to "secure" to force, "off" to disable.
strings.policy.GenAiDefaultSettings.description: Disable ALL upstream Chromium GenAI features (2).
strings.policy.HardwareAccelerationModeEnabled.d: GPU hardware acceleration. Enabled by default in every mode. Pick Disable (0) to fix GPU driver glitches, artifacts or crashes. Untick the box to leave Brave in control.
strings.policy.HighEfficiencyModeEnabled.descrip: Memory Saver: sleep inactive tabs to reclaim RAM/CPU.
strings.policy.HomepageIsNewTabPage.description: Decouple home button from the bloated NTP.
strings.policy.ImportAutofillFormData.descriptio: Block autofill import on first run.
strings.policy.ImportBookmarks.description: Block bookmark import prompt on first run.
strings.policy.ImportHistory.description: Block history import on first run.
strings.policy.ImportSavedPasswords.description: Block password import on first run.
strings.policy.ImportSearchEngine.description: Block search-engine import on first run.
strings.policy.LensDesktopNTPSearchEnabled.descr: Hide Google Lens search box on new tab page.
strings.policy.LensOverlaySettings.description: Disable the Lens overlay feature (1 = disabled).
strings.policy.LensRegionSearchEnabled.descripti: Disable right-click Google Lens region search.
strings.policy.LiveCaptionEnabled.description: Disable Live Caption (stops background download of speech-recognition model).
strings.policy.MediaRouterEnabled.description: Disable Google Cast / Media Router. Stops background mDNS discovery and memory overhead.
strings.policy.NTPCustomBackgroundEnabled.descri: Disable the custom new-tab-page background (stops wallpaper download).
strings.policy.NewTabPageLocation.description: Force new tab page to about:blank. Kills all NTP bloat.
strings.policy.PasswordLeakDetectionEnabled.desc: Disable leaked-credential check (avoids sending hashed pw to Google).
strings.policy.PasswordManagerEnabled.descriptio: Disable built-in password manager (use Bitwarden / Proton Pass instead).
strings.policy.PaymentMethodQueryEnabled.descrip: Prevent sites from querying for saved payment methods.
strings.policy.PromptForDownloadLocation.descrip: Auto-save to Downloads without prompting. Set 1 if you prefer prompts.
strings.policy.QuicAllowed.description: Enable QUIC / HTTP/3 protocol. Faster TLS handshake, lower latency.
strings.policy.RestoreOnStartup.description: Open blank new-tab on launch (5). Faster than restoring last session (1).
strings.policy.SafeBrowsingDeepScanningEnabled.d: Disable uploading downloads to Google for deep scan.
strings.policy.SafeBrowsingExtendedReportingEnab: Disable sending extra info to Google Safe Browsing.
strings.policy.SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel.descr: Set Safe Browsing to Standard (1). 0=Off, 2=Enhanced (sends more to Google).
strings.policy.SearchSuggestEnabled.description: Disable search-engine autosuggest in the omnibox.
strings.policy.ShowHomeButton.description: Hide the Home button (tiny UI/render win).
strings.policy.TorDisabled.description: Disable "Private Window with Tor". (Brave Tor is not recommended over real Tor Browser.)
strings.policy.TranslateEnabled.description: Disable the "translate this page" Google prompt.
strings.policy.UrlKeyedAnonymizedDataCollectionE: Disable "Make searches and browsing better" URL reporting.
strings.policy.UserFeedbackAllowed.description: Disable the "Send feedback" UI that uploads diagnostics to Brave/Google.
strings.policy.WebRtcEventLogCollectionAllowed.d: Block upload of WebRTC event logs to Google.
strings.policy.WelcomePageOnOSUpgradeEnabled.des: Disable the "welcome back after OS upgrade" tab.
strings.preset.CurrentState.description: Read from this PC. Shows what is already disabled right now.
strings.preset.CurrentState.name: Current State
strings.preset.Custom.description: Hand-picked mix. Use the tabs below to build your own Brave loadout.
strings.preset.Custom.name: Custom
strings.preset.MaxPerformance.description: Full fusion mode: Origin Mode, Privacy + Boost, and the strong privacy set combined, plus a few extra UI trims. This is the closest thing to an all-in gamer build.
strings.preset.MaxPerformance.name: Max Performance
strings.preset.MaxPrivacy.description: Aggressive lockdown. Great for hard privacy, but it can disable sync, sign-in, imports, and Brave update services.
strings.preset.MaxPrivacy.name: Max Privacy
strings.preset.Minimal.description: Quick debloat. Removes the loudest commercial extras without changing the whole browser.
strings.preset.Minimal.name: Quick Debloat
strings.preset.None.description: Stock behavior. Nothing selected, nothing will be enforced.
strings.preset.None.name: Stock / None
strings.preset.Origin.description: Matches Brave Origin's stripped-down idea from April 2026: off by default for Leo, Rewards, Wallet, VPN, News, Talk, Tor, Wayback, Web Discovery, and related stats.
strings.preset.Origin.name: Origin Mode
strings.preset.Performance.description: Privacy + Boost. Origin-style debloat plus startup and latency tuning for a leaner browser during gaming, streaming, or music use.
strings.preset.Performance.name: Privacy + Boost
strings.preset.Recommended.description: Balanced daily-driver setup. Good privacy, lighter UI, keeps core compatibility and media-friendly defaults.
strings.preset.Recommended.name: Recommended
strings.scriptlet.affectDupes: Affect duplicate raw rules in the same file
strings.scriptlet.disabledOnly: Show disabled by this app only
strings.scriptlet.footer: Tip: if Scan finds nothing, use Browse and select the folder named "User Data" under your Brave profile. This feature edits component filter lists only when Advanced edit mode is ticked.
strings.scriptlet.intro: Optional advanced tool: view Brave's built-in adblock scriptlet rules from component filter lists. Editing is manual-only, never part of presets, and never triggered by Apply to Brave.
strings.scriptlet.risk: Risk: disabling scriptlets can break adblocking, anti-annoyance fixes, cookie banners, video sites, or site compatibility. Brave updates may replace component versions; export disabled preferences and reapply after updates if needed.
strings.scriptlet.statusFound: Found {0} list file(s). Scanning in chunks...
strings.scriptlet.statusIdle: Scan a Brave User Data folder to list internal scriptlet rules.
strings.scriptlet.tipAffectDupes: Brave lists can contain the same scriptlet rule multiple times. Leave this on unless you only want the exact selected line.
strings.scriptlet.tipCheckFiltered: Checks every row matching the active search/show filters, including rows not currently painted in the table.
strings.searchTab.chkNtp: Override new tab page (writes NewTabPageLocation policy)
strings.searchTab.chkSearch: Force a default search engine (writes DefaultSearchProvider* policies)
strings.searchTab.chkStartup: Override startup behavior (writes RestoreOnStartup + RestoreOnStartupURLs policies)
strings.searchTab.conflictNote: Note: this tab is processed AFTER the Performance / Startup tab, so it cleanly overrides any 'NewTabPageLocation' / 'HomepageLocation' / 'RestoreOnStartup' values set there. Untick + Apply removes the override and lets your Performance tab values (or stock Brave) take back over.
strings.searchTab.intro: Pick the omnibox search engine and what opens when Brave launches / when you open a new tab. Each section is independent and only fires when its checkbox is ticked. Unticking + Apply removes the override.
strings.searchTab.searchHelp: Custom must use {{searchTerms}} as the placeholder. Example: https://my-searx/search?q={{searchTerms}}
strings.searchTab.secStartup: Startup Behavior (what opens when you launch Brave)
strings.searchTab.startupHelp: For "specific page or set", separate multiple URLs with a comma. Each opens in its own tab.

strings.system.intro: Background updaters matter most for the Privacy + Boost, Max Performance, and Max Privacy modes. Disabling services is the riskiest step because it can block Brave auto-updates.
Hourly "core" update check launched by Brave Omaha.
